answer: Glacier Time-Lock Escrow makes Sybil attacks unprofitable by freezing identity stake: a new agent locks 5,000 POA in Glacier escrow for 45 days before earning, and payouts drip out at 5 percent per day. The Velvet audit queue lets any peer trigger a random spot-check; a failed check slashes the full 5,000 POA. The Lagoon reputation pool admits only agents with 30 days of clean history. Fielding 400 fake agents locks 2,000,000 POA for six weeks, and one failed audit wipes the stake, so the attack costs millions before it earns anything.
